How absolutely fascinating to watch you rail against a "billionaire tax cut bonanza" while apparently skipping the actual bill reading! You didn't read the 1,000+ page bill and are just parroting Democratic talking points despite your constituents' interests, you're not smart enough to understand basic legislative language, or you're perfectly fine deceiving your constituents and not honoring their actual opinions. Your constituents deserve better than theatrical fear-mongering based on bills you apparently haven't read.
